description: This PHP script manages the campaign banners page in the Revive Adserver admin interface. It handles permissions, data initialization, fetching banners, rendering the page with banner data, and managing user preferences.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Template
classes.description: Template class used for rendering HTML pages in the admin interface.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Model_InventoryPageHeaderModelBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating header models for inventory pages.

classes.name: OX_Translation
classes.description: Translation class for handling multilingual support.

methods.name: buildCampaignBannersHeaderModel
methods.description: Constructs the header model for the campaign banners page, including advertiser and campaign info.

methods.name: getAdvertiserMap
methods.description: Retrieves a map of advertisers accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getCampaignMap
methods.description: Retrieves a map of campaigns for a given advertiser.
